findings.requirement: The clarifier reads the owner's words in context and asks every blocking question, specific, through the question tool
findings.what: Check 3, two behaviours in one: 23 examples cover at least five distinct behaviours (reading context, assumption versus question policy, relevance filter, logging answers, the false-gap evaluation) and the statement states only the first three. The stale-link example (SR-147/EX-3, evidence line handed to the agent as text) is a stale-link/agent-text behaviour that has no clarifier connection and belongs under P12's 'agent gets everything as text' requirement, which does not carry it. The eval-set false-gap measurement (SR-103/EX-12) is a calibration-reporting behaviour. Split these off or move them.

findings.requirement: Outside the loop the edit gate closes only when a request or edit would contradict or extend a confirmed record
findings.what: Check 3: the statement covers the gate policy and per-session/digest keying, but three examples (settings.json allows the hook but runs none; Claude Code started in src/; legacy install with hook commands, so the plugin hook does nothing) are the 'cannot be switched off by accident' and install-idempotence behaviours (SR-121, P14). Nothing in the statement or title covers them. Also the 30-prompt fixture example tests the judge's quality, not the gate.

findings.requirement: A big request is handled as one set, repaired until clean and approved in one step
findings.what: Check 3: three behaviours under one title, namely suggesting the loop once on triggers (SR-036), repairing a set until clean (SR-094) and set-hash approval by the cascade (SR-037). The example 'plumb relay --set exits 3' only tests a removed legacy command, and 'the stop hook asks for suggestions / the diff-size trigger fires' is implementation wording. Split into suggestion, repair, and set approval.

findings.requirement: /plumb intent opens one intent loop whose stages each run only on the previous stage's passed gate
findings.what: Check 3: the JEV 0.7 / Sonnet questions / above 0.9 example duplicates P9's cascade requirement (P9.json has the same 'JEV scores 0.7' example), the debug-workflow example duplicates P5's requirement, and 'intent not called done until the chosen proof is shown' is P10's. The loop requirement should reference these, not restate them, or they will drift apart. The JEV example also holds two outcomes (0.7 and above 0.9) in one then-clause.

findings.requirement: /plumb intent opens one intent loop whose stages each run only on the previous stage's passed gate
findings.what: Check 4: 'no loop opens; the message is only grounded' is not observable ('grounded' is internal wording). The original (SR-193/EX-4) said 'no loop opens and no model runs', which stays true for this prompt because no confirmed record covers it, so weakening it was unnecessary. Same for Requirement 2: 'the intent is clarified as usual' (SR-154/EX-3) does not say what the owner sees.

findings.requirement: A big request is handled as one set, repaired until clean and approved in one step
findings.what: Check 5: the proof asks the owner to read 'plumb status' showing a set hash and then to edit one member to see the set unconfirmed. The owner does not edit records, read hashes or run status commands (P2, P12), so this is not something the owner could watch. Replace with: the owner sees the one-line suggestion once, answers only the trade-off question, and the plumb line says the set was approved by the judge.
